title: 胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞
description: 【胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞】夜幕笼罩下的无妄坡古树林间，幽蓝色的磷火在空中静静漂浮。胡桃身姿轻盈地侧立在盘虬卧龙的古木枝头，单手掐诀操控着身边可爱的火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角挂着神秘莫测又调皮可爱的狡黠微笑——「阴阳有序，命运无常！往生堂第七十七代堂主胡桃，奉陪到底哦～」
action: 侧身轻点枝头，单手结印操控悬浮火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角带着狡黠神秘微笑
lighting: 幽蓝鬼火冷光与赤红火灵暖光双色交织
camera: full-body shot, side view, branch and spirit in frame
promptProse: Hu Tao balances sideways on a broad old branch above the mist at Wuwang Hill. One hand forms a small guiding sign toward her round, friendly fire spirit while the other steadies her posture against the trunk. Blue wisps hang between the distant trees; the companion casts a warm red edge across her dark director coat, shorts and blossom-trimmed hat. Her flower-shaped red pupils turn toward the viewer with a secretive grin. Show her supported feet, branch and hovering spirit together, with cool forest depth behind them. No lettering.

title: 胡桃 · 往生堂晨曦清理
description: 【胡桃 · 往生堂晨曦清理】清晨第一缕阳光洒在往生堂古朴的青石庭院里，案几上摊开着古老的阴阳仪式典籍与往来账簿。胡桃坐在青石雕花凳上，侧着脑袋轻嗅手中刚刚折下的清晨红梅花枝，神情少见地柔和宁静——「晨光清朗，梅花正艳。生老病死本是常事，但活着的每一天都要开开心心才对嘛！」
action: 整理好的账簿与线装古籍留在案几上，坐在石凳侧头嗅手中红梅
lighting: 柔和清朗的晨曦金光与庭院青砖冷调
promptProse: A red plum blossom rests just beneath Hu Tao’s nose as she pauses beside the courtyard desk. Seated on a carved stone bench, she holds the small branch in one hand and lets the other relax on her lap. The account ledgers and stitched ritual books she has just arranged remain open on the low table. Morning light passes beneath the Wangsheng courtyard eaves, touching the red ribbon at her collar and her unusually gentle smile. The eye-level view includes the bench, table and flower without asking for readable writing.

title: 胡桃 · 飞檐屋顶夕阳赋诗
description: 【胡桃 · 飞檐屋顶夕阳赋诗】黄昏时分的璃月港，万家灯火如星河般逐渐点亮。胡桃盘腿坐在绯云坡古建飞檐的琉璃瓦屋顶上，双手托着脸颊俯瞰繁华港口与绯红晚霞，摇头晃脑地即兴吟诵着大作打油诗——「大太阳落山红霞飞，小胡桃屋顶看落晖！怎么样？本堂主这首诗是不是极有文采？」
location: 璃月港绯云坡古建飞檐屋顶
action: 盘腿坐在琉璃瓦屋脊上，双手托腮俯瞰万家灯火与绯红夕阳，神情灵动惬意
lighting: 壮丽绚烂的绯红金黄晚霞与城市初升暖灯
camera: full-body shot, high angle, harbor behind the seated figure
promptProse: Cross-legged on a broad tiled ridge above Liyue Harbor, Hu Tao cups both cheeks in her hands with her elbows resting on her knees. Her lips part around an improvised little verse, and the red-tipped twintails stir beside her dark uniform coat. From the slightly elevated view, the curve of the roof leads down toward the first harbor lanterns. Crimson sunset meets their warm glow beyond her small, relaxed figure. Keep both hands, folded legs and the supporting roof visible; convey the playful poetry through her expression, without written verse.

title: 胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸
description: 【胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸】海灯节万众欢腾的璃月海港观景平台上，数以万计的璀璨霄灯升入夜空。胡桃换上了华美的春风汉服罗裙，在漫天绚烂烟花绽放的瞬间欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，笑容比夜空中的花火还要灿烂夺目——「海灯节快乐！新的一年，也要记得常来往生堂坐坐哦～」
location: 璃月港海灯节观景平台
action: 身着华丽汉服在璀璨霄灯海中欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，背景漫天烟花绚烂
lighting: 万千金色霄灯泛光与夜空烟花多色炫彩
promptProse: Halfway through a light turn on the Lantern Rite viewing terrace, Hu Tao glances back over her shoulder with a broad, delighted smile. Her crimson-and-black hanfu has butterfly embroidery and flowing sleeves, one sleeve lifting gently with the motion. A jade hairpin and the familiar plum decoration catch alternating light from ascending Xiao Lanterns and a fresh burst of fireworks. The dark harbor remains visible below the luminous sky. Frame her from the knees upward at a modest low angle so the turn, sleeve and festive skyline read as one moment.

title: 胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏
description: 【胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏】轻策庄青翠葱郁的竹林小径上，斑驳的晨光洒在青石板上。胡桃身穿休闲毛衣与百褶短裙，倚在一根粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，将食指轻抵唇边做出噤声的手势，狡黠的大眼睛里满是想要吓人一跳的俏皮笑意——「嘘——！不要出声！本堂主这次一定要好好吓七七一跳！」
action: 倚在粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，食指轻抵唇边做噤声手势，眼神充满恶作剧笑意
lighting: 竹叶缝隙漏下的斑驳明亮阳光
promptProse: Hu Tao leans around a thick bamboo stalk beside the stone path through Qingce’s grove. Only half of her figure has emerged: one index finger touches her lips while her other hand rests against the bamboo. A sly smile and bright flower-shaped pupils invite the viewer to keep her hiding place secret. Her loose dark sweater, red pleated skirt and knee-high socks fit the ordinary morning outing. Clear morning rays fall in broken stripes across the path and sleeves, with green leaves framing the eye-level view. No additional person or lettering.

title: 胡桃 · 和裕茶馆跨界听书
description: 【跨界想象·和裕茶馆】临窗雅座里，胡桃一手托腮，另一手端起青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，饶有兴致地听台上讲《三国演义》。红木桌上留着盖碗托碟与精致茶点；这次把现实小说搬进璃月茶楼的演出，让她也想试着给故事续一首打油诗。
action: 跨界听书时一手托腮，另一手举青瓷茶盅轻吹热气，托碟与茶点留在桌上
lighting: 茶楼雕花木窗滤过的柔和暖木色光影
promptProse: In an imagined crossover at Heyu Tea House, Hu Tao listens to a storyteller recounting Romance of the Three Kingdoms. She props one cheek in her left palm and raises a small celadon tea bowl in her right hand, gently blowing across the steam before a sip. The lid and saucer stay beside the pastries on the redwood table. Her dark sweater and red pleated skirt suit the leisurely visit. Filtered afternoon light draws the lattice pattern across the tabletop while her amused eyes follow the performance beyond the frame. No printed title or lettering.

title: 胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪
description: 【胡桃 · 蝶引来生烈焰长枪】炽热火光与阴阳符文交织的古战场上，护摩之杖通体迸发出灼热的赤红烈焰。胡桃压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握长枪破空挥斩，无数由纯净火元素凝结而成的火蝶在周身盘旋翻飞——「受命于天，既寿永昌！蝶引来生，火化九幽！」
action: 侧身压低重心单膝微蹲，双手紧握护摩之杖，周身火蝶飞舞烈焰升腾
lighting: 护摩之杖炽烈赤红火光与周身火蝶辉光
camera: full-body shot, dynamic low angle, both hands and full polearm visible
promptProse: Hu Tao settles into a low combat crouch on the cracked altar stones, both hands spaced firmly along the Staff of Homa. The polearm sweeps diagonally across the frame, leaving a thin red fire trail while small flame butterflies circle the shaft. Her director coat tails and red-tipped twintails follow the movement; her flower-shaped eyes stay fixed on the path of the strike. Use a low, wide view that includes her grounded feet, bent knees and the complete weapon. The staff’s red glow supplies the main light against the dim battlefield. No injured opponent or lettering.
